quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing press release: DNP, NEXEL and CMIC Pharma Science Establish Joint Venture (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Health care / drug-discovery support: on October 9, 2026 DNP established TriNebula Cell Tech Co., Ltd. as a joint venture with NEXEL Co., Ltd. (Seoul; develops and manufactures cell products derived from iPS cells) and CMIC Pharma Science Co., Ltd. (non-clinical testing services) to focus on the global marketing and commercialization of human iPS cell-derived products, including cardiomyocytes, proposed to pharmaceutical companies, chemical and cosmetics manufacturers, CROs, universities and research institutions. Under a licensing agreement with NEXEL, DNP will manufacture cardiomyocytes and aims to establish a global manufacturing and sales structure based on the market and customer needs identified through TriNebula's marketing activities.
